description: Set component property values for UI components or custom script components. Supports setting properties of built-in UI components (e.g., cc.Label, cc.Sprite) and custom script components. Note: For node basic properties (name, active, layer, etc.), use set_node_property. For node transform properties (position, rotation, scale, etc.), use set_node_transform.

componentType.description: Component type - Can be built-in components (e.g., cc.Label) or custom script components (e.g., MyScript). If unsure about component type, use get_components first to retrieve all components on the node.

nodeUuid.description: Target node UUID - Must specify the node to operate on

property.description:
Property name - The property to set. Common properties include:
• cc.Label: string (text content), fontSize (font size), color (text color)
• cc.Sprite: spriteFrame (sprite frame), color (tint color), sizeMode (size mode)
• cc.Button: normalColor (normal color), pressedColor (pressed color), target (target node)
• cc.UITransform: contentSize (content size), anchorPoint (anchor point)
• Custom Scripts: Based on properties defined in the script

propertyType.description: Property type - Optional. When omitted, the server infers it from the target property metadata. You can still specify it explicitly for ambiguous cases or to override inference.

value.description:
Property value - Use the corresponding data format based on propertyType:

📝 Basic Data Types:
• string: "Hello World" (text string)
• number/integer/float: 42 or 3.14 (numeric value)
• boolean: true or false (boolean value)

🎨 Color Type:
• color: {"r":255,"g":0,"b":0,"a":255} (RGBA values, range 0-255)
  - Alternative: "#FF0000" (hexadecimal format)
  - Transparency: a value controls opacity, 255 = fully opaque, 0 = fully transparent

📐 Vector and Size Types:
• vec2: {"x":100,"y":50} (2D vector)
• vec3: {"x":1,"y":2,"z":3} (3D vector)
• size: {"width":100,"height":50} (size dimensions)

🔗 Reference Types (using UUID strings):
• node: "target-node-uuid" (node reference)
  How to get: Use get_all_nodes or find_node_by_name to get node UUIDs
• component: "target-node-uuid" (component reference)
  How it works: 
    1. Provide the UUID of the NODE that contains the target component
    2. System auto-detects required component type from property metadata
    3. Finds the component on target node and gets its scene __id__
    4. Sets reference using the scene __id__ (not node UUID)
  Example: value="label-node-uuid" will find cc.Label and use its scene ID
• spriteFrame: "spriteframe-uuid" (sprite frame asset)
  How to get: Check asset database or use asset browser
• prefab: "prefab-uuid" (prefab asset)
  How to get: Check asset database or use asset browser
• asset: "asset-uuid" (generic asset reference)
  How to get: Check asset database or use asset browser

📋 Array Types:
• nodeArray: ["uuid1","uuid2"] (array of node UUIDs)
• colorArray: [{"r":255,"g":0,"b":0,"a":255}] (array of colors)
• numberArray: [1,2,3,4,5] (array of numbers)
• stringArray: ["item1","item2"] (array of strings)

name: component_set_component_property
